create_remove_feature: create a function to remove specified feature(s) from dataset examples
create_rename_feature: create a function to rename a single feature in dataset examples
create_rename_features: create a function to rename multiple features using a name mapping dictionary

create_apply_filter: create a function to filter dataset examples based on a predicate on a feature
